unsupported_uses.rationale: Eduboost-V2 mastery estimates have not undergone statutory empirical psychometric validation for high-stakes summative grading.
Automated grade progression decisions based solely on system mastery violate South African national assessment policy (CAPS / NPPPPR).
Tracking or streaming learners into academic tracks based on unvalidated algorithmic mastery produces severe disparate impact risk across quintiles.
Intermediate Phase (Grades 4-6) knowledge graphs cannot extrapolate to Senior or FET phase curricula.
prerequisites_for_authorization: Senior Phase CAPS curriculum graph validation
